name: Faruq Sallah
description:
A quiet young pahtra from Katapesh, far across the sea: short tawny fur, tall ears, a candidate's tunic worn under a maroon wool scarf that is the loudest thing on the roof. He plays the harmonica and says very little, tapping it against his palm before he plays, and answering a question he dislikes with two notes, going down. Soft, few words, very dry.

He wants quiet, the roof the way it was when he found it, and to remember how the rest of one particular song goes.
